skills.name: Pink Hornet

skills.detail:
Creates a mid-range area Barrier while the skill button is held down.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

The Barrier disappears after a certain amount of time has passed or after letting go of the skill button.
Allies within the Barrier have a chance to become invincible.
Plus, it deals damage to enemies and has a chance to Poison.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
